adapter_selection: The probe does not pin an adapter: it creates the context through render_opengl::configureOpenGlContext, exactly like the 2026-11-01 seek gate. The host inventory is recorded; the chosen adapter is not printed by this probe, so the two seek batches share the same selection path but neither states the adapter by name.
power_and_affinity: PD_ENV rows in every run log record process/thread power throttling state, affinity mask and priorities; all rows show process_power_state=0 and full affinity 0xffff.
